scripts.title: OPEN SOURCE Silent Aim
scripts.script:
-- // Read Description

warn("Start !!")
-- // --
local Plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local LclPlr = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local Mse = LclPlr:GetMouse()
-- // --
local function GetTgt()
    local Tgt, Dist = nil, math.huge
    for _, Plr in Plrs:GetPlayers()do
        if Plr == LclPlr or not Plr.Character then
            continue
        end
        local Head = Plr.Character:FindFirstChild('Head')
        local Hum = Plr.Character:FindFirstChild('Humanoid')
        if not Head or not Hum or Hum.Health <= 0 then
            continue
        end
        local Pos, OnScr = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(Head.Position)
        if not OnScr then
            continue
        end
        local D = (Vector2.new(Mse.X, Mse.Y) - Vector2.new(Pos.X, Pos.Y)).Magnitude
        if D < Dist then
            Dist = D
            Tgt = Head
        end
    end
    return Tgt
end
-- // --
local RayFn
for _, Fn in getgc(true) do
    if typeof(Fn) == "function" and debug.info(Fn, "l") == 3162 and #debug.getupvalues(Fn) == 4 then
        RayFn = Fn
        break
    end
end
local ShootFn
for _, Fn in getgc(true) do
    if typeof(Fn) == "function" and debug.info(Fn, "l") == 3225 then
        for Key, Value in debug.getupvalues(Fn) do
            if Value == RayFn then
                ShootFn = Fn
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if ShootFn then 
        break 
    end
end
local OldRay = debug.getupvalue(ShootFn, 21)
-- // --
debug.setupvalue(ShootFn, 21, function(Spread, Origin)
    local Tgt = GetTgt()
    if Tgt then
        return { Position = Tgt.Position, Normal = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Distance = 1, Instance = Tgt }
    end
    return OldRay(Spread, Origin)
end)
-- // --
warn("Done !!")

scripts.features:
RONIX GaG2 (KAITUN) — config-driven auto-farm. No menu, no UI: edit the
getgenv().Settings block, run it, and it farms. Same engine as the full
Ronix GaG2 hub, just headless — lighter on weak phones, great in the
background, and built for auto-execute / alt accounts.

FARMING
- Auto Harvest with filters: seed, mutation (only-mutated), minimum value, protect-list (never harvest), burst/0-delay
- Auto Plant: pick seeds, set spacing, choose active beds/slots, burst delay
- Auto Water: per-interval, choose a specific watering can or any owned

SELLING & GAMBLE
- Auto Sell: on an interval, when bag hits a % full, or via the Daily Deal 5x sell
- Teleport to Steven to sell, or sell in place
- Auto Double-or-Nothing: cash out after N wins, with its own interval
- Sell whitelist: keep (favorite) chosen fruit so it never sells

BUYING / SHOP
- Auto Buy Seeds, Gear, and Crates from the shop (only-if-in-stock, per-item lists, intervals)

OPENERS
- Auto Open Crates, Eggs, and Seed Packs
- Auto Use Gears, Auto Expand Plot (with retry/intervals)

GRAB & PICKUP
- Auto Grab dropped seeds (Gold / Rainbow / Seed Packs), return-after
- Auto Pickup ground drops

PETS
- Auto Buy by type or rarity, including any BIG (2x) / HUGE (4x), Only Rainbow, with a max-price cap
- Auto Equip best pets, Auto Sell junk pets (value threshold)
- Find Pet: server-hops until a wanted wild pet is found; uses pet teleporters when owned

STEALING
- Auto Steal from other plots: night-only, target select, valuable-only + min value, evade after steal, max-chase, burst
- Auto Hop until Night
- Anti-Steal: highlight thieves, auto-clear and return home

PROTECTION
- Anti Fling / Ragdoll / Freeze / Flash
- Auto Fling a player or all players (power, hold, interval), crowbar hit nearest, target picker

WEBHOOK
- Discord webhook farm reports (seed/gear/weather + sheckles) on an interval
- Rare event alerts (bloodmoon / rainbow moon), pet-buy alerts, restock watch

PERFORMANCE & UTILITY
- FPS Boost: strip textures, shadows, particles, other players, other gardens, world UI, plant FX — all in one tap, or keep individual details
- FPS Cap, Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin on kick/DC, Auto-Skip Loading Screen
- Save / Load / Reset config

HOW TO USE
1. Edit the getgenv().Settings values at the top (every option is commented with what it does + its range).
2. Execute. No panel pops up — it just runs your config. Leave any key out to keep its default.
3. Filters are lists: {} = all/none per the comment, else names e.g. {"Carrot","Tomato"}.
